notes.title: AGF Update July 18
notes.content:
Hi all!

It's been a little while, but we finally have another update for you.

In this update, we've increased the maximum terrain size from 4000 to 16000. This allows for much bigger terrains if you desire. Be careful though, as large terrains may tend to take a longer time to load.

Next, there is the ability to add height and slope constraints when painting textures onto terrains. So, if you want a texture to only appear at sea level, or on a hill, this could be useful for you.

Objects can now be grouped in the Object List window. This allows you to hide everything inside of the group and could be useful if you want to hide a house roof and edit the objects inside.

You can now use certain objects as vegetation. Be aware however, that more than the most simple objects may not appear correctly as objects with too many polygons may be too much for it to handle.

For those of you with Premium, there are new Paint and Vegetation options on the Terrain Generator. This can allow you to generate a more detailed terrain.

Lastly, for those of you with Voxel Sculpt, you can now generate smaller portions of the terrain at a time. This will allow you to do it quicker and save your AGF from crashing due to memory usage.

Enjoy!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=shFZs5_q41c

notes.title: March 20, Update
notes.content:
Hi all!

This update contains a few small fixes and tweaks.

First, the autosave toggle settings were not being saved between sessions. This has been fixed.

Second, fonts used in the intro and outro of the FPS player story were not showing up correctly. This has been fixed

Third, the battery pickup in the FPS players has been fixed.

Fourth, the initial settings window for the FPS players as well as Platformer and ARPG players has been removed. This is so that you can still customize your splash screen and menu background without worrying about seeing any default info before even opening your game.

Fifth, some tree shaders in the Scene Loader have been fixed. They were showing up pink.

Sixth, the preview tile in the World Builder warehouse would stop rotating when you use the Select Tool. This has been fixed.

Seventh, Depth of Field has been added back into the World Builder. This was removed a while back.

Eighth, the internal FPS player camera rotate speed has been reduced by 33%. Hopefully this will give it a less breakneck feel when you look around.

Enjoy!

notes.title: March 10, Update
notes.content:
Hi all,

This update is all over the place.

The first change is merely minor GUI fixes in the external players.

The second change is a fix to the ammo pickups in the FPS players. Some of them were not disappearing on pickup, and may have swapped weapons to an empty one.

The third change is a bit exciting. You now have the ability to change the splash screen and background of the FPS players, as well as the Platformer and ARPG players.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z7hKyxLoksg&t=1s

Each of the players now has the ability to interact with sidescroller objects, such as the super jump and barrels. In the future, I would like to add something like a shop so you can spend your sidescroller coins for stuff like health and ammo.

Lastly, a shader error in the scene loader has been fixed. Certain trees were importing without a shader, causing them to be pink.

Enjoy!

- There were a few errors in the Scene Loader causing scenes using custom textures to load incorrectly.

- The Properties window in the World Builder now has the ability to set the health, number of respawns, and number of FPS waves. More attributes will be added soon.

Enjoy!

notes.title: November 8, Update
notes.content:
Hi all,

This update adds the ability to customize the music that plays in each of your levels. To do this, in the AGF World Builder, go to Windows > Music.
On new scenes it will have a default selection already set up for you.

Also, you may have noticed that the music playlist selection in the external players has been removed, and due to a bug the music itself was gone from recently created scenes. This was in preparation for this new scene specific music feature. Sorry for the inconvenience.

In the future, there will be a way to import your own music and sound effects.

We fixed a bug in the FPS players causing the camera to be lower to the ground during the startup countdown, as if you were crouching.

In the AGF World Builder, the option to view the help slides using Help > Enabled Help Slides has been missing. This bug has been fixed and it is available once more.

In the FPS players, the A3 assault rifle had a texture error, causing it's scope to be grayed out. This has been fixed.

Just a reminder to some, that the AGF Scene Loader was created to work with Unity 5.4.0f3, and may not work with other versions of Unity. It will be updated for the latest version of Unity in the next update.

Enjoy!

Enjoy!

notes.title: July 1, Update
notes.content:
Hi all,

In this update we added checkpoints for use in the Platformer, ARPG, and FPS players.
When you walk over these and then die, your character will respawn at the last one you walked over.

We also added some properties to start and end locators.
To see these properties, open up the Properties window and select a Start or End Locator.
The start locators have a property now called a Start Tag.
These can be useful for setting specific transitions between levels, such as entering and exiting buildings.
The end locators now have a property called Target Level. Enter a level name into this field, and if you have a scene saved as that name it will become the next scene loaded.
The end locators also have a property called Target Start Tag, while the Start Locators now have something called a Start Tag. If you write something in this field for the end locator, and a start locator in the next scene has the same tag, that will be where you start.

If you own the Drone Kombat DLC, you may have noticed the automatic doors. These used to only work in the external players. They now also work in the internal players.

Lastly, in the FPS internal player used to jump into the air when you first spawn. This has been fixed.

If you have any questions about or suggestions for object properties, feel free to let us know!

Enjoy!

notes.title: UPDATE 07.31.2015
notes.content:
Hello all, 

Many changes, additions and fixes have been made in this build.

Fixed- The AGF launchpad so that the information is now on a scrollable window for smaller screens
Fixed- Voxel grass memory leak
Fixed- The saving protocal for the world builder is now set up for both mouse and keyboard inputs. So the issue with Linux users not being able to save scenes has been resolved. 
Fixed- Shader errors on assets. Error only seen on some graphics cards. 

After much testing with different machines trying to re-create some bugs with the FPS controllers spinning and with no success of re-creating the bug here. We decided to add user defined keybinds to many of the applications. This feature has also been requested by users for  other reasons.  This allows users too change the controller set ups and shortcut keys to fit their specific needs. 

Added- User defined key binding to these apps:

	World Builder
	Constructor
	FPS  Shooter
	Zombie Shooter
	Drone Kombat

-Added- Story Mode Off/On toggle. Top of Story Editor
-Added- Locked and Unlocked asset notation at preview window
-Added- Information panel [?] for locked and unlocked assets at preview window
-Added- Screen capturing to user defined location, Lower right of work space

Updated the AGF scene loader for Unity. Fixed bug when too many voxel types were made in the World Builder and those scenes not being loaded into Unity properly. 

Made another pass at updating the external ARPG and Platformer players since the move to Unity 5.0. 

Known issues:

Multi-Player in the World Builder and Drone Kombat is not working correctly in some cases. The networking code is in the process of being rewritten. 

The external Arpg and Platformer players are better then previous builds but character controllers and combat systems are not complete and do have issues that need to be addressed. 

The file path requestor/browser is blank (black) on Linux machines when selecting a path for screengrabs. This makes the new screengrab feature unusable on Linux at this time. 

-Removed- Linear fog gui, because it hasn't work since AGF went to Unity 5.0, it had no use.
-Removed- Load Last project button. It was creating project/scene file curruptions. We decided it was best that it be removed to stop scenes from getting corrupted. 


Happy Creating,

AGF Team

notes.title: GeoVox is NOW LIVE!!!!
notes.content:
We are pleased to Announce that we just launched [url=store.steampowered.com/app/368470/] GeoVox - on Steam![/url] 

GeoVox is the latest real time world generation software application created by Axis Game Factory, Inc.  GeoVox is a completely new stand-alone Voxel based real-time terrain creation tool. 

GeoVox instantly creates lush AAA quality environments at the start of the application.  Designed with intuitive game like controls it allows users to test for level playability as they are creating.  

[b]Key Features:  [/b]
  [b]User Experience[/b]
•	Instant environment is generated at application start 
•	Simple tools that allow users to edit the environment as needed without a steep learning curve
•	Clean, low overhead GUI that allows for fast terrain editing, without limiting users creativity
•	Standard game controls to allow users to explore their environment to simulate gameplay
•	Flying Camera or FPS style with gravity and jump ability camera modes
•	Full real-time Voxel based terrain editing
  o	  Easily edit the terrain with simple point and click volume brushes
  o	  Define Voxel brush sizes and shape
  o	  Single click and click and drag on Voxel application
  o	  Offset Voxel brush from center or base
  o	  Brush snapping
  o	  Add Voxel volumes
  o	  Cut Voxel volumes
  o	  Paint Voxel volumes
  o	  User definable smoothing 
  o	  Cut volumes and Paint textures and apply environmental assets simultaneously  
  o	  Create a pallet of Voxel types to be used in your environment
  o	  Voxel types can include textures, assets and vegetation
  o	  Mix and match variables to create many Voxel types
  o	  Voxel types can be applied upright or aligned to terrain normal
  o	  Assets can have user defined depth off-sets 
•	Fully featured fractal algorithmic terrain generator 
•	Limited or Infinite terrain editing abilities (user decides and determines how large they want their maps)
•	Create from hundreds of pre-packed, license free assets to use for professional development
•	Assets include:
  o	  Trees
  o	  Plants
  o	  Rocks
  o	  Shrubs
  o	  Flowers
  o	  Grasses
•	Library of terrain textures included with color, normal and specular maps
•	Real-Time, user defined Ambient Occlusion 

[b]Input/Output[/b]
•	Create Asset Packs for use with Geovox using the AGF Asset packager and Unity FREE
•	Importing of AGF Asset Packs for use in Geovox
•	GeoVox to .Obj exporting
  o	  User defined export location
  o	  User defined export size
  o	  All mesh assets export with transforms applied 
  o	  All images export in .PNG format

[b]Product Road Map of Future Updates / DLC - will be added at a later date[/b]
•	.Obj Importing directly into Geovox (future update)
•	Networked (8) user Environment Collaboration. Private (Password Protected) and open Rooms (future update)
•	Importing of the Geovox Terrain Format (Raw Mesh data) to Unity 5.0 (future update)
•	Importing of the Geovox Terrain Format to the AGFPRO Editor (future update)
•	Importing of the Geovox Terrain Format to the AGFPRO Player DLC (future update)
•	Package and Share your completed Geovox Terrains with an re-distributable Geovox Player (future update)
•	Importing of the Geovox Terrain Format to the AGFPRO editor (future update)
•      Asset Packager for use with Unity 5.0 Free to GeoVox asset package format (future DLC - additional cost)

notes.content:
[b]Hey There AGFPRO Users - 

We have been head's down for the past two weeks working on tons of updates, new features and fixes!  Below is a comprehensive list of the work that we have done (itemized by dates)![/b]

The biggest news we have to share is that we have just added a brand new "Story Editor" to AGFPRO and all of the DLC's with the exception of BattleMat.  What this means, is that you are now able to add images and text to the beginning and ending of every scene you create to make your own story, so your own story will unfold as your scenes are linked together in AGF and the DLC's.  Tomorrow, Matt will be providing a video tutorial of how all of this works!  It is very straight forward, similar to a basic version of Power Point.

Here is the list - ENJOY!

* Prefabs work best when they are centered to the world coordinates
* New centering tools ensure this will happen

* Another bug found by "THEDARKMATTER"

notes.title: Axis Game Factory MAJOR Updates - FREE Update to AGFPRO 3.0 and new DLC Voxel Sculpt Released Today 3/23/2015
notes.content:
Hi AGFPRO Fans!

[h1]Great news today!!  We just released AGFPRO v3.0 that is compatible with Unity 5 and our latest DLC - VOXEL SCULPT!!!![/h1]  

This major update includes  new characters and character controller for the ARPG and Platformer Players. Enjoy making larger and more detailed  environments with higher frame rates!

AGFPRO 3.0 works with ALL of the DLC's - Fantasy, Zombie, BattleMat, Drone Kombat and Premium!! 

Voxel Sculpt is the latest downloadable content (DLC) in Axis Game Factory’s AGFPRO line of products, geared to allow users the ability to rapidly create game levels and maps in real-time without having to program, model or animate.  

What is a VOXEL???  Voxel is short for volume pixel, the smallest distinguishable box-shaped part of a three-dimensional image.  Voxel Sculpt empowers users the ability to create unique and custom worlds one voxel at a time.  By adding or subtracting voxels, users can create bridges, tunnels, caves, floating platforms, buildings and assets using soft or hard-edged voxels, any size, and with any texture for limitless possibilities.

AGFPRO’s Voxel Sculpt works with ALL of the DLC’s – Fantasy, Zombie, Drone, BattleMat and Premium – is compatible with Unity 5.0 and will work with all future DLC releases as well.  

Key Features include:
•	Allow users to add voxel assets to their maps in the same manner that AGF allows them to add any other assets through the warehouse

•	Auto generate voxel terrains on the fly with a simple to use interface

•	All additions to the voxel shapes use all the same “tool-tip” transform and placement and snapping tools

•	Users are able to duplicate and transform these voxel assets as needed after the Voxel asset is created

•	Select from many primitive shapes

•	Users are able to create their own texture combinations as they like, from the terrain textures that are already available in AGFPRO

•	Custom Images can be loaded for use with voxels

•	Saving, Importing and sharing of voxel assets with other AGF users

•	Exporting of voxel assets in a format that allows for them to be imported into many 3D applications

•	All AGFPRO DLC will support Voxel Sculpt asset types

•	Voxels are destructible

•	*The main application, AGFPRO 3.0 is required to use Voxel Sculpt DLC

[b]Voxel Sculpt and Voxel Sculpt + AGFPRO 3.0 are on SALE this week for 15% OFF - so NOW is the time to get this amazing DLC!!![/b]

notes.title: Weekly Update - Pay Attention for the BIG AGFPRO 3.0 Details!!
notes.content:
Hey Guys,

So things have been super crazy over here at Casa de McDonald...  With so much going on, we thought it best to summarize it all in an update and give you some rough dates as to when changes are going "live" as well as post resources for users that will want to keep using the former version of AGFPRO 2.0 (this is only necessary if you are locked into an older version of Unity 4).

1.  AGFPRO 3.0 is coming this week!!!  We are tying our major updates to Unity's and as most of you know, it takes some time for us to get everything synced up, so we appreciate your patience and have been making this our primary focus as we know many of you are anxious to get this working with the latest and greatest Unity.  We will likely still be working through some bugs, so if you see anything, we can start a thread titled, "AGFPRO 3.0 Bug List" and you all can organize anything you come across on that thread so we can have some organization.  We anticipate most errors showing up on Mac and Linux versions as we work primarily on PC (and Mac), and 90% of our users are PC's, so there you have it.

2.  If you want to revert to the last version of AGFPRO 2.0 after we push the update, you will need to use the Beta version agfprov2_for_unity_4.6.3f1,  Right click on AGFPRO software in your library, go to properties and the Beta tab is right there.  

3.  New DLC coming next week!!!  We have a really cool DLC launching early next week, Voxel Sculpt!  Users will be able to create and sculpt their terrain using Voxel technology, which really opens up your ability to create unique and interesting spaces.  We have tons of cool features packed into this DLC, including a "numeric  terrain generator" feature, where you select your values and a terrain is automatically generated using fractal algorithm variables.  Lots of fancy terminology for "floating islands, tunnels and caves!!!"  This is really going to be cool for you platformer guys and gals as you can place floating terrain and make some really epic scenes!  *Please note that Voxel Sculpt will work with ALL of the DLC Players as well!  Fancy, right??  

4.  Auto Trax - another NEW DLC in the works!  We had planned on pushing this one at the end of the month, but the Unity update sort of set us back two fold as we had to put resources into AGFPRO 3.0 as well as change the physics and other tech with the Auto Trax DLC so it works with AGFPRO 3.0 and Unity 5, so we are now looking at early April for Auto Trax!  If you haven't heard, this is a special DLC that expands our genres to include track creation, there will be tons of track assets in this DLC to choose from.  It will also feature several vehicles that you can make changes to and effect performance as well as appearance.  Way points and scoring will be key features to provide some fun game play mechanics as well.  We will do our best to push this, but we need to get things sorted out and it's looking like two to three weeks out at this time.  I will be sure to update everyone if things change.

5.  Finally - the BIG question we have been dealing with is, "Are you going to charge us for AGFPRO 3.0???"  The answer to that is, "Not this time."  We didn't charge our users for the 2.0 update and we decided to hold off on this one as well, but we may in the future need to charge as you all know, we work on AGFPRO 24/7 and continue to expand features and functionality, so long story short - no - it's free!!  Just keep spreading the word to your friends, classmates, teachers, game groups, etc. and we'll be able to keep the lights on :)

That's it for now, as always, be sure to send us any questions if you have them.  Post positive reviews if you love us, and share your work, we love to see what great levels you are all making!

All the best,

Axis Game Factory Team

[*]Multi-Player - up to 8 players[/list]

Key Features Include:

[*]Dynamically Template Searched Assets to expedite your map making (added to AGFPRO)[/list]

Multiple Weapons include Primary and Secondary:
[list][*]Quad lazer cannon
[*]Rockets
[*]Magnetic mines
[*]Shields
[*]Bombs
[*]Health[/list]

An Elaborate HUD System Includes:
[list][*]Rearview Camera
[*]Enemy Targeting
[*]Stats
[*]Team/Co-op

notes.title: New Patch Live 11/27/2014
notes.content:
Welcome Everyone,

We have been working hard to update AGFPro and it's New DLC Battlemat!

[h1]AGFPro Updates:[/h1]

Today we bring you a great addition to AGFPro Construct. The toolbar that our customers have found very useful in AGFPro World Builder, is now also in Construct. Offering you more options to use AGFPro the way that best suits your needs.

For AGFPro - Premium Edition: A new in both AGFPro and the Construct tool is the ability to Mirror objects that you are placing by the Z or X axis. This will make building things that require symmetry like a Castle, really quick and easy. 

I made this [url=https://www.dropbox.com/s/2w3o9fe928kabwf/Screenshot%202014-11-26%2019.42.30.png?dl=0] CASTLE [/url] in 8 Minutes 30 some seconds.. using the new mirroring tools in AGF.. THE BUILD TIME IS IN THE LOWER RIGHT CORNER..



An alignment option was added in AGFPro World Builder grid system which helps in lining up Tiles for use in Battlemat. You would use this option when working with our Dungeon Tiles or with the new Interior Tiles.



[h1]AGF - Battlemat DLC Updates[/h1]

We have added an Interior Tile Set so now you can build house interiors just like you build dungeons.

As well as few other little fixes, that have slipped my mind.

ADDED A CAMERA AXIS and HIEGHT LOCKING FEATURE..


* We are aware that the Dice are not tinting properly but we will have it patched soon. 
DICE FIX IS COMPLETE AND UPLOADED TO STEAM, 19:14 11/26

[h1]UPDATE 11.27 [/h1]

*We made some changes and fixed some small bugs in The World Builder, the Construct tool and Battlemat today.. 27.2014 

[h1]UPDATE 11.27 MAC AND LINUX USERS[/h1]

I also found that there were some files missing for Mac and Linux that are now in place. These files were not allowing several of the apps to work properly.  If there are any further MAC or LINIX issue please let us know ASAP. 

Thanks... 

Matt

notes.title: Update.
notes.content:
We made several updates this last week.. 

You may have already seen, as this feature was implemented a couple of weeks ago, 

[b]AGF now imports and exports Height Maps.[/b]

Import PNG files from anywhere to AGF to create terrains. This is only an AGFPRO "Premium" Feature. If you do NOT own the AGF premium DLC you will not see this feature. 

If you don't know if you have AGF "Basic" or "Premium" you will now. I added different art to the loading screen to show you what version you have. 

The height map importing is not as polished as id like it to be... I need to add some GUI so users can control the offset and displacement of the imported textures and the effect they have on the terrain. 

This can be achieved by adjusting the "height" value inside the Terrain>Modify menu. I am not happy with this as the only option. I will add the additional GUI for the height maps as soon as I can.

In an earlier version "Number 13" pointed out a bug where the imported maps were flipped on the X. This has been fixed in the height map importer.. THANKS NUMBER 13 ;)

[b]>>>IMPORTANT CHANGES TO OVERALL USE>>> PLEASE READ>>>>[/b]

To further AGF being more easily used on laptops when a mouse is not available. We made more features available from the tool bar.

When you start AGF now there are not any tools selected at all. Just your cursor. You can select the tools as you want as you like. Clicking on the Home and File mode icons will drop whatever tool you have on your tool tip. I meant to get a "drop tool" icon in but it fell through the cracks. I will get that in in another build. Right clicking on the tool bar icons will toggle them off. 

There are a full set of camera control buttons you will see on the far right.. If you  have a small screen use the slider bar to see them. 

I made the camera follow OFF as a default. Yes, I heard your complaints. :) There is now a button to toggle it on and off. 

I added a 3 button mouse, icon/button that will make the camera now work like the one in Unity. Please let me know what you think..

Most all of the object mode tools are now available on the tool bar. Some features that users were not seeing are there. Object offset repeat, Object Grow. Align object to normal and Object collision on off toggle. 

We also made the all the players available on the tool bar now. 

We worked out some camera issues on the ARPG and Platformer players.
Fixed some bugs with the particle effects and character combat.
I sped up the animations so the characters play faster. Much more fun now..
Added object occlusion transparency to both the internal and external ARPG and Platformer players. So the objects between the camera and the character now go transparent automatically.

Alex added some better camera control and collision code to the players.
I made a new "location to go" animated object that points where your character will move to in both the internal and external ARPG players.
 
I made several changes to improve overall speed performance in the editor. You will see the terrain sculpting is a bit faster now. The massive speed difference between painting and sculpting has been somewhat addressed I will continue to work on this to get it as good as I can. The objective is to have things run as fast as possible while still feeling balanced. I made changes to the quality settings to ensure there were no code, heavy features that would degrade performance.

You will see now that the terrain will change in detail the farther back you are from it. This is to keep frame rate consistent. We added a feature that turns off the shadows while you are sculpting to increase speed. There is a button on the terrain menu to turn this off. It is set on by default. 

The bug where the Editor was not launching the Constructor properly has been fixed. We are still working on the Prefabs updating in the editor scene properly when you send a prefab from the constructor to the editor. They do update in the Warehouse/Prefabs container correctly though. To update Prefabs that are already placed in the scene you need to reload the scene.

I agree this is not ideal. I will get that fixed soon.. too... ;) 

There were some issues with a build that the textures were not being loaded properly for .OBJ files. This has been fixed. I made some changes to the .OBJ importer. You may see a better quality of shader now on the imported assets. 

There are even more features added, But this update note is getting huge. I will post on another note soon. 

Thanks, 

Matt

Happy Creating..

notes.title: Axis Game Factory Launches version 2.0 of AGFPRO's Entire Software Suite
notes.content:
[h1]AGFPRO V2 Updates and New Features Added:[/h1]

Today, we are excited to announce the release of version 2.0 of the Axis Game Factory Suite of software for rapid level and game world creation.

Major new features have been added to [b]AGFPRO, AGFPRO PREMIUM, AGFPRO Zombie FPS Player DLC, and AGFPRO Fantasy Side-Scroller Player DLC.[/b]  With a brand new interface and a more simplistic way to create, the entire AGFPRO suite makes it easier than ever to design your game levels with the power of a prominent professional toolset. 

[b]New Features include:[/b]

[u][b]New AGF Launch Pad[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]This App replaces the AGF editor from the AGF icon in Steam
[*]Launches all AGF Apps including the Editor from one toolbar
[*]No need to go through the Editor to launch the Players
[/list]

[u]][b]New AGF World Editor Features[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Redesigned GUI
[*]Dropdown menu system
[*]Collapsing, drag-able windows with easy to see icons
[*]3x Speed increase for terrain sculpting
[*]Terrains can now be sculpted to 200 meters up and 200 meters down max
[*]Terrains are now expanded to a maximum terrain of 4000 meters square
[*]10 levels of undo for terrain editing
[*]Undo Vegetation, Painting and Sculpting independent of each other
[*]Via the new integrated AGF Browser, users can now import their own original:  Brushes, Terrain Textures, Terrain Vegetation Textures in .PNG format
[*]Edit the entire Default Brush library for users preference
[*]Project specific and default brushes independent of each other
[*]Underwater Fog added
[*]Underwater Lighting added
[*]Camera automatically changes the atmosphere when users are underwater vs. above water
[*]Added a "Build Time Clock" that is saved with each scene file every time users work, creating a standing time on how long each level takes to create
[*]Updated GUI in the Editor
[*]Custom Images can be both loaded and removed for the Brushes – Terrain and Vegetation 
[*]Enhanced Grid-Snapping Features:  
     [*]On screen display of Grid Size
     [*]On screen display of Grid-Snap Setting 
     [*]There are now reference numbers for both the X and Z Axis, the numbers change dynamically with the scale of the grid
     [*]Grid Reference Number Scaling and Display Settings can be defined by the user 
[*]There is now an NPC manager that is available when users place NPCs
     [*]Users are able to customize text to give NPC’s scripts and sort the order in which the players are guided to speak and interact with the NPCs
     [*]Users are able to name NPC characters
[*]New Smoothing Feature for the terrain sculpting has been added to give the user the ability to smooth and softer terrain on their maps
[*]New X, Y, Z directional compass added to the Editor
[/list]

[u][b]New Construct App Feature:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Gone is the old prefab workspace and it has been moved into its very own App
[*]Construct is where you go to create your own prefab assets from the always-expanding library of textures and assets (over 1,000+) that are available in the AGFPRO Warehouse
[*]Users can launch Construct from the Launchpad or from the Editor
[*]Use the “refresh assets” button to load prefabs into the Warehouse library
[*]Construct allows users to import their own .OBJ files (objects or assets) as well as .PNG texture files
[*]Load your own models, .OBJ files, directly into Construct – USERS NO LONGER HAVE TO IMPORT THEIR OWN ASSETS THROUGH UNITY PRO!!!!! 
[*]Combine several .OBJ files and save them as a Prefab to be used in the World Editor
[/list]

[u][b]New AGF Browser (file browser)[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]This is a standalone browser that connects the AGF Apps together!
[*]The new AGF Browser is designed to be the glue that is used to bring in users custom content.  Now users are able to bring in their own Textures and Objects files (Assets) into AGF creations without the necessity of using Unity Free or Unity Pro… This feature is HUGE as it empowers users the flexibility to create their own custom levels with any supported asset types they choose to bring in with the ability to take their scene files back into Unity to publish their own work 
[/list]

[u][b]New AGF Packager[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]By popular demand – we have added this great feature… AGF DLC users are able to package their games easily and share with anyone!  Just do the following:
[/list]
[olist]
[*]Select the Game Type 
[*]Select the Project Folder
[*]Select the Destination of the New Game onto User’s Machine
[*]Give a Name to the Game
[/olist]
[list]
[*]… And the AGF Packager does the rest… it’s really that easy!  Best of all, friends do not need to own AGF to run the packaged game, nor do they need to have a Steam account. The Packaged Game is completely stand-alone, DRM FREE, and redistribution of users game(s) is encouraged. AGF Packager will make a game for the OS that it was packaged on. The AGF packaged games are NOT intended for resale. It’s about creating and sharing with all.
[*]As an option, the Packager will automatically zip the game(s) package for easy distribution and no installation is required for the end user to play – no installers are necessary for friends to play – just unzip and have fun!
[/list]

[u][b]New AGF Scene Loader Features:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Custom Images that are used on terrains now load into Unity with scene created in AGF
[*]Any locked assets in an AGF scene are no longer an issue… The AGF/Unity Scene Loader skips any assets that are not supposed to load automatically 
[/list]

[u][b]New Premium Features:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Brand new AGFPRO Scene loader compatible for Unity 4.5.2f1
[/list]

notes.title: Axis Game Factory Launches Zombie FPS Player DLC!!!
notes.content:
[h1]Zombies attack Axis Game Factory's AGFPRO and PREMIUM!![/h1]

We are pleased to announce that we have just released our latest DLC pack - Zombie FSP Player for AGFPRO and Premium!!  

Zombie FPS Player is a new DLC for Axis Game Factory’s AGFPRO and PREMIUM that allows users the ability to create their own 3D Zombie Shooter games from a first-person shooter perspective.  

Packed with tons of assets, features and game player mechanics, users are able to create endless custom Zombie themed games that include: five custom enemy types of characters each with unique abilities and animations, a wide variety of weapons, health and other pick-ups, assets tuned with game-play mechanics, environment assets for interior and exterior map creation, explosive assets, scene-linking for endless map connections, FPS game play, sounds, sound effects, and custom placement for all enemy characters, start and end points.  Get ready for some serious fun and immediate satisfaction creating your own Zombie FPS games to play AND share with your friends!!

Features Include:
•	Player Start Locations
•	Player Exit Locations
•	Enemy Placement
•	Variety of weapons
•	Player Pick-Ups – weapons, ammo, health, etc.
•	FPS Game Play
•	Game Play Mechanics 
•	Five unique Enemy Zombie Characters included
•	Custom animations set for all Zombie Characters
•	Assets programmed with Game Play Mechanics 
•	Destructible assets 
•	Scene-Linking – Players are able to connect maps with start and exit points for endless gameplay
•	Custom GUI
•	Sound and Sound Effects 


Additional characters, assets and gameplay features will be released in future DLC packs!

The Zombie FPS Player is on sale NOW for the next week (ends May 30th), so get your Zombie fix now!!

notes.title: General Update on New Features and the Axis Game Factory Roadmap
notes.content:
[b]After a very busy week at the Steam Dev Days Conference, we wanted to share some very exciting updates that the AGFPRO and PREMIUM community can expect in the coming weeks and months ahead![/b]

[list]
[*]  Steam Workshop - we are currently setting up a Workshop for AGFPRO users to share their scene files, maps and assets.  Workshop will include UGC and we will allow users the ability to monetize from the sale of their content.  

[*]  New update coming for AGFPRO that will include a "save" feature for image terrains and splat maps.  We will also allow users to save image files to re-create terrains in other programs to allow the export of image files to use in any program that uses height and splat map based terrain.  - This will enable users to create maps and MODS for other games (and sell them in our Workshop).

[*]  GUI Design update for AGFPRO and PREMIUM - Header and tool shelf will be added with icons as an alternative to using the radial menu

[*]  Update to allow AGFPRO users the ability to import OBJ files directly into the software

[*]  New DLC "RPG Hack'n Slash" Maker

[*]  New DLC "Peep" Characters (66 characters in all with custom animations)

[*]  New DLC "Off-Road Racing" Player with gameplay mechanics and custom vehicle creation kit

[*]  New DLC "Side-Scroller" featuring the Peeps with gameplay mechanics

[*]  New Browser Code to allow the importation of .WAV files and images with a display feature

[*]  New Assets in Pre-Fab to support interior environments and additional genre themes

[*]  New textures for texture library

[*]  New Character Creation feature

[*]  Scene-linking - allows users the ability to connect start and exit points with other maps making endless gameplay for your scenes and connecting with others
[/list]

These upcoming features are listed in no particular order for release and we will post a new announcement for each new feature and/or software update as they become available.

One final note to consider - if you are a developer and wish to use AGFPRO to MOD your game, give us a call - we would love to work with you and provide you with the necessary source code to make it happen!!

Thanks for all of the support - we love what we do and have much more to be sharing with you in the near future!

All the Best,
The Axis Game Factory Team
